about_the_game:
Welcome to the Village That Time Forgot.

Far from the maps, deeper than the woods, lies a village steeped in silence — and something far more sinister. Abandoned for generations, its streets remain untouched by time, its houses eerily intact, and its air heavy with whispers of forgotten rituals. When an unexpected storm strands you nearby, seeking shelter quickly becomes a descent into something much darker.

In this horror puzzle experience, you'll explore the remnants of a cursed village trapped between worlds — a place where reality fractures, time loops, and the boundary between the living and the damned blurs. You'll uncover old manuscripts, ritualistic artifacts, and unsettling symbols etched into stone and flesh alike. What happened here? Why do the bells still toll in the night? And what is it that stalks the woods just beyond the treeline?

Rituals, Riddles, and Ruin

  • Solve a series of increasingly complex environmental puzzles and occult challenges as you dig deeper into the village's haunted past.

  • Every puzzle is a piece of the ritual — some must be broken, others completed. Choose carefully.

  • Not everything wants to be solved. Some riddles were left behind for a reason.

Unseen Forces Lurk

  • Face a growing, invisible presence as you progress — demons tied to ancient rites and bound to the land itself.

  • Your every action tips the balance between salvation and damnation.

  • Avoid being seen, heard… or remembered.

A Story Carved in Blood and Silence

  • Discover the fate of the villagers through scattered notes, whispered confessions, and ghostly echoes.

  • Learn the twisted mythology behind the curse — and the ancient rites meant to contain it.

  • Your role is not accidental. The village called for someone. It called for you.

short_description: Trapped in an abandoned village shrouded in darkness, you must uncover the truth behind ancient rituals, solve eerie puzzles, and survive the demonic forces that haunt the land. Break the curse, banish the evil—before it claims your soul forever.

English*, Turkish
*languages with full audio support
